entries.land_location_as_stated: on an old blue stone quarry with a lovely, secluded pond
entries.description: A lesbian separatist homestead of 3 lesbian women on 45 acres in Saugerties, NY, on an old bluestone quarry with a pond. They grow almost all their own food with gardens, a solar greenhouse, dairy goats, poultry, and fruit trees, hold Herbal and Psychic Healing Intensives every summer, and are working on wheelchair accessibility for their house and campsites. They welcome lesbian women of all ages as visitors for up to five days.
entries.raw_text: ROWDYBUSH FARM (Susun Weed & Clove), 3136 Fishcreek Rd, Saugerties, NY 12477. Our dream is to be part of a network of SAFE SPACES for wimmin. Right now we are a hard working lesbian separatist homestead on an old blue stone quarry with a lovely, secluded pond. We provide almost all our own food with three large gardens, a solar greenhouse, dairy goats, chickens, ducks and fruit trees (to be planted this spring). We support the land partly by working outside jobs and partly by holding Herbal and Psychic Healing Intensives every summer. We are working on wheelchair accessibility for house and campsites. We welcome lesbians of all ages as visitors for up to five days, $2-5/day donation. We have/are: 3 lesbians, 45 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, wimmin living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because 3 lesbians live and work on the land ('3 lesbians... wimmin living and working on the land'). Land address copied from street mailing address as residents live on the land. Accepted groups: Lesbian women from 'We welcome lesbians of all ages'; although they mention a dream of 'SAFE SPACES for wimmin', they explicitly state 'we are a hard working lesbian separatist homestead' and 'We welcome lesbians'. Focuses: Lesbian separatism ('lesbian separatist homestead'); Farming/self-sufficiency ('homestead', 'provide almost all our own food with three large gardens, a solar greenhouse, dairy goats, chickens, ducks and fruit trees'); Workshops/education and Spirituality/ritual ('holding Herbal and Psychic Healing Intensives every summer'); Disabled women ('working on wheelchair accessibility for house and campsites').

entries.description: A women's land community in its 6th year on 150 acres in Alpine, NY, with 6 to 10 lesbian women living and working on the land. They have permanent structures, plumbing, electricity, woods, farmland, and camping space, focus on healing, farming, and self-sufficiency, and welcome girl children, maybe visitors, and cautiously new members.
entries.raw_text: NORTHWOODS RD 1 Box 156, Alpine, NY 14805 (607)594-3536. (Between Ithaca & Watkins Glen, NY.) Northwoods is in its 6th year as womyn's land, now moving this spring to a more focused use of the land than just gardening and living. We're investing in farm equipment and need work energy. Healing is a focus of many of us. We need everyone here to be self sufficient and self motivated. We welcome: visitors (maybe), new members (perhaps, cautiously), girl children. We have/are: 6-10 lesbians, 150 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative as 6-10 lesbians live and work on the land ('6-10 lesbians... women living and working on the land'). Land address copied from rural route mailing address ('RD 1 Box 156'). num_residents is 6, the lower bound of '6-10 lesbians' with 'women living and working on the land'. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (questionnaire directory listing with '6-10 lesbians' and 'We welcome: visitors (maybe), new members (perhaps, cautiously)') and Girl children ('girl children'). Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency ('investing in farm equipment', 'need everyone here to be self sufficient'); Spirituality/ritual ('Healing is a focus of many of us').

entries.land_location_as_stated: in a hollow on a creek in the mountains of WV
entries.description: A homestead of 2 lesbian women on 25 secluded acres in a hollow on a creek in the mountains of Jumping Branch, WV, accessible by foot or 4-wheel drive. The residents are carpenters, woodworkers, blacksmiths, and farmers who have a permanent structure, electricity, woods, farmland, and camping space, teach skills to serious apprentices, and welcome visitors, apprentices, and girl children.
entries.raw_text: MISTY BOTTOMS FARM c/o Mimi & Judy, Rt 86 Box 15A, Jumping Branch, WV 25969. We are building a womyn's homestead on 25 acres in a hollow on a creek in the mountains of WV. Secluded land, access by foot or 4-wheel drive. We are carpenters and woodworker/blacksmith as well as farmers. Will teach skills to serious apprentices. Visitors welcome and expected to help (bring own food). We welcome: girl children and apprentices. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 25 acres, housing/permanent structure, electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('c/o Mimi & Judy', 'We have/are: 2 lesbians', welcoming visitors and apprentices but not recruiting new residential members). Land address copied from rural route mailing address ('Rt 86 Box 15A'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women (questionnaire directory listing welcoming visitors and apprentices) and Girl children ('We welcome: girl children'). Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency ('building a womyn's homestead', 'as well as farmers') and Workshops/education ('Will teach skills to serious apprentices').

entries.description: A collective of 7 lesbian women living and working on 40 acres in Holly Springs, MS, striving toward self-sufficiency. They have permanent structures in process, a communal kitchen, outdoor plumbing, electricity with RV hook-ups, woods, farmland, and camping space. They are not separatists and welcome lesbian women, non-lesbian women, girl and boy children, and leashed dogs for visits with work exchange or cash.
entries.raw_text: SILVER CIRCLE FARM c/o Gwen O Demeter, Box 100 Rt 5, Holly Springs, MS 38635. We are a collective of seven wimmin dedicated to caring for 40 acres and each other. We strive to tolerate our differences as well as enjoy them. We are striving toward self sufficiency. Visits require work exchange and/or cash for short stays. Longer visits/meals negotiable. Have communal kitchen. We are not separatists. We are spiritual, artistic, scientific, political, but most important we are loving wimmin trying to give each other space to grow! We welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, dogs (but only on leash). We have/are: 7 lesbians, 40 acres, permanent structures (in process), outdoor plumbing, electricity (also hook-ups for couple of RV's), camping space, woods, farm land, wimmin living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('We are a collective of seven wimmin... wimmin living and working on the land'). Land address copied from rural route mailing address ('Box 100 Rt 5'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women (questionnaire directory listing), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children and Boy children ('girl and boy children'). Rejects separatism ('We are not separatists'). Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency ('striving toward self sufficiency'), Spirituality/ritual ('We are spiritual'), Archives/cultural work ('artistic').

entries.description: A community of 6 lesbian women (4 living on the land) on 18 acres in Red Rock, TX, 35 miles southeast of Austin. They have 2 permanent structures, electricity, woods, and camping space, and are developing a self-sufficient farm with livestock, a garden, an orchard, and a stained-glass and spinning workshop. They have a rule against drugs, alcohol, and cigarettes, and welcome lesbian women and girl children for short visits.
entries.raw_text: EARTH CURRENT FARM Rt 1 Box 137L, Red Rock, TX 78662 (512)764-2706. We are a family of 6 lesbians, 4 on the land. We are developing a self sufficient space 35 miles SE of Austin, that will provide most of our food and bring in at least part of our survival money. Our plans include chickens, goats, sheep, rabbits, a garden, orchard, and a stain-glass and spinning workshop. We welcome: girl children and dogs (maybe leashed). Visits limited to 2-3 days, $2 per person or work exchange, no drugs, alcohol or cigarrettes please. We have/are: 6 lesbians, 18 acres, 2 housing/permanent structures, electricity, camping space, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('We are a family of 6 lesbians, 4 on the land... women living and working on the land'). Land address copied from rural route mailing address ('Rt 1 Box 137L'). num_residents is 4 ('6 lesbians, 4 on the land'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women (questionnaire directory listing) and Girl children ('We welcome: girl children'). Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency ('developing a self sufficient space... that will provide most of our food... chickens, goats, sheep, rabbits, a garden, orchard'), Archives/cultural work ('a stain-glass and spinning workshop'), Recovery/substance-free ('no drugs, alcohol or cigarrettes please').

entries.land_location_as_stated: deeply forested, sub-alpine beauty at 3200'; near incredible Yuba River
entries.description: A couple of 2 lesbian women in their 40s, vegetarians and non-smokers, living and working on 13 deeply forested, sub-alpine acres near the Yuba River in CA. They have a trailer, shed, electricity, well, camping space, woods, and an organic garden and orchard. They are looking for 1 to 3 semi-collective members and welcome lesbian women, non-lesbian women, and girl and boy children.
entries.raw_text: CEDAR c/o Linda or Sara, PO Box 274, Camptonville, CA 95922. We are a couple in our 40's, vegies/non-smokers, living on 13 acres, deeply forested, sub-alpine beauty at 3200'. Looking for 1-3 semi-collective members, very hard to make a living locally, rural, quite isolated, wet winters, hot summers, near incredible Yuba River, other parcels for sale nearby and looking for lesbian buyers. We welcome: new members, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 13 acres, trailer, shed, electricity/well, camping space, woods, organic garden/ orchard, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative: although currently a couple ('2 lesbians'), under the two-woman rule it becomes Intentional Community/Cooperative because they already live on the land and actively recruit members ('Looking for 1-3 semi-collective members'). Mailing address is a PO Box, so land_street_address, land_city, and land_zip are left blank; land_state is CA from mailing address and 'near incredible Yuba River'. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (questionnaire directory listing), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children and Boy children ('girl and boy children'). Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency and Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('vegies/non-smokers... organic garden/ orchard'). Non-smoking alone is not coded as Recovery/substance-free per codebook.
